No obfuscated code, suspicious commands (e.g., curl|bash, base64 decoding, eval), or unauthorized network operations are present. All dependencies are relevant to the project's scientific and quantum computing purpose. The use of `--system-site-packages` in the venv is acceptable in test contexts, especially when testing integration with other Qiskit components. Overall, the script adheres to secure and standard AUR packaging practices.
